findings.claim: The mutual-exclusion paragraph uses build-internal role labels without mapping them to concrete files, so the exclusivity/auditability statement is not locally checkable from this appendix alone.
findings.evidence: The paragraph names the "full DFS compatibility stream", "compatibility synthesis-support master", and "platinum master", but it never states which file each label denotes.
findings.required_action: If the paragraph is meant to be self-contained, add a short glossary or spell out the file-path mapping on first use.

findings.claim: The proof-support route is split between the prose route description and the crosswalk row, so a reader using only the table will not see the Technical Derivation Atlas named where the prose says local proof support lives.
findings.evidence: The opening route description points local proof support to Appendix~\ref{sec:oc-core-1-3-technical-derivation-atlas}, but the "Use or compare the model" row ends with the section range for proof or replay support and does not repeat that appendix.
findings.required_action: Optional: add the Technical Derivation Atlas to the crosswalk's proof-support branch, or relax the prose so the atlas is not singled out as the local proof-support destination.

findings.claim: The table says every inspection target is label-checked, but several target cells still use prose names instead of explicit cross-references, so the navigation claim is a little stronger than the table itself.
findings.evidence: Rows in the table name the axioms, notation, reviewer-navigation, proof-machinery, journal-core bridge, and source-audit appendices in prose rather than as explicit \ref links.
findings.required_action: Optional: replace the prose appendix names with explicit refs, or narrow the label-checked claim to the cells that are actually cross-referenced.

findings.claim: The inspection-burden table is only partially self-checking because several targets are named by prose shorthand rather than explicit cross-references, so the "label-checked" claim is not fully transparent from the table itself.
findings.evidence: The row text uses names like "Axioms Appendix", "Notation Appendix", "Reviewer Navigation Matrix", and "Proof Machinery Appendix" instead of explicit `\ref{...}` targets, while other rows do use explicit section references.
findings.required_action: If local checkability matters, replace the shorthands with explicit appendix references or add a legend that maps each shorthand to a file or label.
